speaker: Ms Hany Soh
text: asked the Minister for Communications and Information with respect to the announcement by the National Library Board on 7 November 2023 that it will cease its subscription to an e-learning platform from 15 December 2023, whether the Ministry has considered any solutions to defray the cited reason of a significant increase in cost so that public will be able to continue benefitting from access to the platform.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
text: NLB will continue to work with SSG and other local and overseas partners to provide more online learning resources and encourage lifelong learning among Singaporeans.

speaker: Ms Hany Soh (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
text: I have three supplementary questions for this question.

speaker: Ms Hany Soh (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
text: The second supplementary question is in relation to alternative platforms for the users, how do they measure up against the current Udemy Business platform?

speaker: Ms Hany Soh (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
text: And finally, how will the Ministry or, specifically, NLB assist members of the public with the transitions from the current platform to its replacements, especially when it comes to addressing their needs on work or studies?

speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
text: I do not think it would be appropriate for me to share some of the commercial sensitivities that might be tied to the proposal.

speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
text: Allow me to use an analogy to explain.

speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
text: In the past, you go to a restaurant, you pay a price at the door, you go in.

speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
text: If it is a buffet, you choose what you want and you eat all you can.

speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
text: You can go to the cooked food section, there is a seafood section, a salad section, there are hot stations where they prepare food for you, then you have the drinks section and the desserts section.

speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
text: Choose what you want and eat all you can for a fixed price.

speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
text: But with a new model, maybe a restaurant tells you that the price that you pay at the door is a few times higher now; and when you go into the restaurant, you are only entitled to a plate of rice and maybe two or three dishes from the cooked food section.

speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
text: Anything else, you would have to top up or pay extra.

speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
text: So, now, you are no longer able to go to the salad section, you cannot go to the drinks section, you cannot go to the desserts section and you cannot go to the seafood section.

speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
text: So, the question for us is: with a much more expensive and costly model, does this still meet the needs of our learners?

speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
text: We assure the Member Ms Hany Soh and other Members that NLB is very concerned about the nutritional needs of our Singaporeans, especially the nutrition of the mind, their learning needs.

speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
text: We are actively exploring what other platforms can provide such needs for our learners.

speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
text: At the same time, we also shared with many members of the public who wrote in about some of the other alternative resources.

speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
text: It is a platform where NLB provides curated resources for our learners.

speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
text: We also shared a list of other platforms that are available for learners to tap on in the meantime, as we look at other resources, other online platforms for our learners, in the future.

speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
text: So, I wish to assure Members that this is something that NLB is very, very keen on because we want to support the lifelong learning and discovery needs of Singaporeans of all ages.

speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song (Aljunied)
text: I just heard the Senior Minister of State say that learners can use the SkillsFuture Credit to claim for Udemy courses.

speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song (Aljunied)
text: But the last time I checked on the SkillsFuture website, Udemy courses are not available.

speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song (Aljunied)
text: It used to be, a long time ago, but it was discontinued for some time already.

speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song (Aljunied)
text: And, as far as I know, there is only one online course provided called eCornell.

speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song (Aljunied)
text: So, can the Senior Minister of State confirm that what he said just now is still accurate?

speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
text: But perhaps, if Mr Giam would like to seek specific clarification on specific courses, he can write to us.

speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
text: We will take a look and check it out.
